4) 10 min — open Q&A / procurement next steps

Thanks Sarah — happy to present the results. Quick notes from the SE side so we can make the session actionable:

- Confirmed slot: Tue 23 Mar 09:00-10:00 PST works for me.
- Can you confirm the QPS distribution you want us to focus on (steady 100qps vs. spike tests)?
- If you want us to reproduce any tests against your environment, we'll need a short-lived staging token and network allowlist for one IP (we can coordinate with your infra team).
